question: Which of the following male athletes was crowned the 'World Athlete of the Year' in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mondo Duplantis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mondo Duplantis** is a Swedish-American pole vaulter known for his exceptional achievements in athletics. He has consistently dominated the sport, breaking numerous world records in pole vaulting.
 
• In **2025**, Mondo Duplantis was crowned the **'World Athlete of the Year'** by World Athletics, recognizing his outstanding performances and contribution to the sport.
 
• Duplantis holds the **world record** in pole vaulting, achieving a height of **6.22 meters** during the indoor season in 2023. This record solidifies his status as one of the greatest pole vaulters in history.
